notes:
I couldn't write these notes. My research tools stopped working before I could read any pages. The first attempt, which tried to open eight commentary pages at once (Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit, Barnes, JFB and the NET Bible notes), went over the tool's usage limit and returned nothing. When I tried again with just the Enduring Word page, the tool refused because I had no calls left for this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes: anything I wrote now would come from memory and have no real URL behind it.

**Next steps:** Ask me again in a new message and I'll read the pages one or two at a time so I stay under the limit. I'd go in this order:
1. **Main reading, verse by verse:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/micah-2/, then the biblehub.com commentary pages for Micah 2 (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit, Barnes, JFB), then preceptaustin.org.
2. **Modern scholarship:** the netbible.org notes on Micah 2, especially the hard verses 4, 6–7 and 11.
3. **Where traditions differ:** searches for how each tradition reads vv. 12–13 (the "One who breaks open the way"). Gill, Wesley and others take it as the Messiah, while others read it as the return from exile. Also Catholic, Orthodox and Lutheran readings, and any modern prosperity-style use of "the breaker" in v. 13, if the sites discuss it.

If you'd like, I can do just one part per message, such as "verses 1–5 from Enduring Word and Ellicott," so each part gets finished.
